components.name: StorySpec
components.purpose: Provides canonical structured narrative data (characters, scenes, props).

components.name: Story Analyzer
components.purpose: Parses raw text into a StorySpec using Gemini API or heuristic NLP rules.

components.name: Character Registry
components.purpose: Stores and retrieves canonical character anchors and biometric embeddings.

components.name: Visual DNA
components.purpose: Metadata and ArcFace embeddings representing the unchangeable core identity of a character.

components.name: Scene Planner
components.purpose: Resolves scene properties, calculates denoising schedules, and prepares base control inputs.

components.name: Prompt Builder
components.purpose: Generates structured prompts including demographic tags and regional isolation boundaries.

components.name: Generic IP-Adapter
components.purpose: Primary identity conditioning engine using CLIP-ViT-bigG.

components.name: FaceID Plus V2
components.purpose: Alternative identity conditioning engine utilizing native face embeddings and LoRA.

components.name: InstantID
components.purpose: Designed for identity injection, but currently inactive due to Forge runtime preprocessor errors.

components.name: OpenPose
components.purpose: ControlNet adapter enforcing specific human poses, activated automatically by the Healing Controller.

components.name: Depth
components.purpose: ControlNet adapter for spatial geometry enforcement.

components.name: Regional Conditioning
components.purpose: Partitions prompt attention using BREAK tokens and regional ratios to prevent attribute leakage.

components.name: LoRA
components.purpose: Adds localized style or detail weights to the generation process.

components.name: FreeU
components.purpose: Native U-Net modification re-weighting backbone frequencies to improve image coherence.

components.name: PAG
components.purpose: Perturbed Attention Guidance; enhances structural integrity natively.

components.name: CFG-Fix
components.purpose: Dynamic thresholding to prevent color burning at high Classifier-Free Guidance values.

components.name: Adaptive Denoising
components.purpose: Modulates Pass 2 img2img strength based on the scene's shot type (e.g. close-up vs. wide).

components.name: ReActor
components.purpose: High-fidelity faceswapping post-processor applied during Pass 2 to force facial likeness.

components.name: CodeFormer
components.purpose: Face restoration algorithm run alongside ReActor to enhance clarity and repair artifacts.

components.name: ArcFace
components.purpose: Biometric QA metric calculating cosine similarity between generated faces and canonical anchors.

components.name: CLIP
components.purpose: Semantic QA metric scoring zero-shot probabilities of required or forbidden props.

components.name: VLM
components.purpose: Vision-Language Model for holistic visual evaluation. Unverified/inactive in current automated QA flow.

components.name: HealingController
components.purpose: Detects QA failures and triggers re-generations with tuned parameters.

components.name: CrossFrameConditioner
components.purpose: Intended to pass visual history between frames, but unused in the current Generation Orchestrator flow.
